# OpenModeration

> AI comment moderation adapted to your own rules and use cases, DSA-compliant and hosted in the EU. The OpenModeration team adapts it with you to your rules, use cases and edge cases, then every comment on your site, Facebook, Instagram and YouTube is handled automatically, with a written reason for every decision, for far less than manual or outsourced moderation. Book a call: https://calendly.com/pierre-logora/60min

OpenModeration protects social media pages and communities from hateful comments, spam, and scams. It is built for community managers, small businesses, media newsrooms, and creators — not just developers. Open source (AGPL v3), made and hosted in the EU, GDPR-compliant.

## Who it is for
- Community managers and social media teams drowning in toxic comments and spam
- Brands, retail, luxury and fashion houses whose comment sections hurt their image and sales
- Local authorities and public institutions running consultations and civic participation
- Teams looking for an alternative to an outsourced moderation agency
- Media newsrooms facing waves of hate under hot news on their social accounts and in the comment sections of their articles
- Developers needing a moderation API (separate track, same platform)

## How it works
1. Connect your Facebook, Instagram, or YouTube account in a few clicks
2. Set your rules once: forbidden words, category thresholds, and your own rules in plain language (one-click `balanced` preset)
3. The AI hides what clearly breaks your rules; borderline cases go to your team's review queue (Approve / Reject in one click)
4. Every decision — AI or human — is logged with a written reason, ready for audits

## Key facts
- **Your rules**: rules written in plain language, forbidden/suspect words, per-category thresholds, presets (light / balanced / strict), modes (auto / mixed / manual), per-source settings
- **Transparent**: written justification for every hidden comment, full AI + human audit log, open-source code, EU hosting
- **Easy to set up**: protected in about 5 minutes, no developer needed
- **Onboarding**: the OpenModeration team adapts the moderation to each customer's rules and use cases, starting from their real comments, and fine-tunes it over the first weeks
- **Learns from your decisions**: the system learns from moderators' decisions and proposes adjustments to the rules, applied in one click by an admin
- **Context-aware**: the AI reads each comment with the title of the post it belongs to and the discussion thread
- **Risk-free trial**: sandbox mode analyses real comments and shows what would have been decided, without applying any action on connected platforms
- **Platforms**: Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, WordPress (native connectors); any other content via REST API and webhooks
- **Scale**: more than 10 million comments moderated every day
- **Customers**: news publishers including L'Équipe, Challenges, Sud Ouest, actu.fr, Estadão, Südkurier and Egora
- **Languages**: the website is available in English, French, Spanish, German and Italian
- **Pricing**: Free cloud plan (1,000 requests/month ≈ 30 comments/day); Pro at €99/month (10,000 requests/month ≈ 300 comments/day, managed keys, priority support & SLA); Enterprise custom (dedicated infrastructure, custom SLA); free unlimited self-hosting via Docker
- **DSA compliance**: user reports handled and logged (Art. 16), written statement of reasons for every decision (Art. 17), exportable figures for transparency reports (Art. 15), human review of contested decisions (Art. 20); GDPR-compliant EU hosting
- **Trust**: AGPL v3 open source, no vendor lock-in, bring your own provider keys (BYOK) optional

## For developers
REST API (`POST /v1/moderation`), multi-provider routing (OpenAI, Azure, Mistral, HuggingFace, Cohere, Hive, Perspective, LLM via OpenRouter), standardized scores across 10 categories, batch up to 10,000 items, webhooks, TypeScript-friendly. Docs: https://api.openmoderation.com/docs

## License
AGPL v3. Fully auditable, no vendor lock-in. Self-host free, unlimited.
